notes.title: The Volcano is Watching: Free Infernal Map Incoming
notes.content: [h3][b]Noble Kings![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The time has come to expand the horizons of your royal gaze. [b]Village[/b] and [b]Graveyard [/b]have served as noble proving grounds, but a kingdom such as yours deserves more variety, more peril, and more wonders to conquer. That is why our next step is the addition of a [b]brand new map[/b], a biome unlike anything you’ve ruled before: the [b]Volcano![/b][/p][p][/p][p]With it comes not just a change of scenery, but a whole[b] new set of mechanics, events, bosses, enemies, buildings, [/b]and [b]artifacts[/b] to challenge even the most seasoned monarchs.[/p][p][/p][p]We are aiming to release this update [b]later this year[/b], [b]closer to December[/b]. Development is still at an early stage, so consider this an announcement of direction rather than a royal promise. Things may shift as the fires of creation continue to burn, but rest assured: this is where the development leads us![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Welcome to the Volcano[/b][/h2][p]This time your ruling extends to a precarious settlement built at the foot of a [b]vast volcano. [/b]Officially, you tell your subjects you’re here for[b] rare alloys and valuable ores[/b]. But only your closest advisors know the truth: [b]your true aim is to study the occult, [/b]for sages whisper that volcanoes are gateways to the Infernal dimension. [/p][p][/p][p]You’ve had your share of dealings with demons before (sometimes even at your services) but what if you could speak with one of their [b]Archdukes, [/b]someone higher in the infernal hierarchy? What bargains might such a creature strike? And what blasphemies might you unleash by accepting?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Realm of New Gameplay Possibilities[/b][/h2][p]The map itself will evolve with the [b]volcanic cycle[/b], shifting through around [b]five distinct stages[/b]. These will change[b] not just the appearance[/b], but [b]also the gameplay[/b], keeping every part of the run tense and interesting. And should you play your cards right, you might find yourself negotiating directly with an [b]Archduke of the Inferno[/b]. Will you accept his infernal pact, or reject it and carve your own path without such unholy aid? The choice will be yours.[/p][p][/p][p]To make things more interesting, [b]Threat Levels[/b] on this map will be [b]uniquely tuned[/b]. Much like how Graveyard is unlocked after beating a certain Threat Level, Volcano will require the same. So we think that you will be ready for a new challenge and [b]distinct modifiers[/b]. Expect them to be fiercer than on other maps, shaking up the predictable spikes of difficulty you’ve grown used to.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/NehVCYS.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Infernal Enemies Await[/b][/h2][p]Every new map brings its own host of horrors. Just as zombies shamble across the Graveyard and goblins terrorize the countryside of the Village, the Inferno will send forth its legions to batter down your gates. Expect twisted [b]imps [/b]darting across the skies, hulking [b]demons [/b]pounding at your walls, and relentless waves led by [b]mighty bosses[/b], each with their own agenda, powers, and reasons to see you fail.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/50006e44171d4b364457ca33d89e458e81046ce7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/a609b3b302b7f2cedcc803ecea8c6f9ffc18031c.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]Tools to Match the Challenge[/b][/h2][p]But fear not, noble rulers, because with new dangers come new ways to prevail. This update will introduce:[/p][list][*][p][b]Esoteric artifacts[/b] preserved only by the fickle mercy of demons, granting powers unlike anything seen before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infernal-themed buildings[/b], expanding your kingdom’s reach in strange and dangerous ways.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recruitable creatures[/b] from the Infernal realm, willing to serve in your armies… if you dare to command them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potentially even new advisors[/b], drawn from otherworldly planes, ready to whisper their cryptic counsel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/b3479dd067e88b6e9cea3eba265569295b325cff.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/717004958234560ae715268c5755314f74360432.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Events, New Dilemmas[/b][/h2][p]A new map would not be complete without [b]stories and challenges[/b] to match its tone. Expect to see a host of fresh events, each presenting dilemmas to test your judgment. Below you may see an example and also several royal illustrations we are ready to share with you, [b]handcrafted by the court’s best human artists![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/ae64e9fe47cab3bdad127d3eb7da741cfcca88da.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The nobles of your kingdom whispered in secret, poring over forbidden tomes and hoarding rare ingredients. Their obsession bore fruit - or perhaps fire - when at last they succeeded in summoning a powerful Lord of Hell.[/i][/p][p][i]Bound within a blazing circle, the demon offered them a single wish in exchange for freedom. Unfortunately, your subjects immediately began shouting conflicting demands: eternal life, death to their rivals, unmatched skill in the bedroom - the list went on, and on, and on. Hours passed in bickering while the demon, clearly regretting his career choices, finally reached out to you in desperation.[/i][/p][p][i]Now, Your Majesty, the circle still burns, the nobles still argue, and the demon waits for your word to end this absurd stalemate.[/i][/p][olist][*][p][i]Set the demon free in exchange for the wish[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Kill the cult members and imprison the demon forever[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Blow out the summoning candles and see what happens next[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]And here other royal illustrations:[/b][/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/a2833a2da203740f33b3e02b70e4a7c185a746fc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/efcb7edb9c2a27cb05c2e593cd44c71ddae89fa5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c02ffe9612beb789170bff5046ad92ea63da64a0.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]New Music for a New Realm[/b][/h2][p]Alongside the Volcano map, we’ll be adding a full set of [b]new music tracks[/b], created to capture the ominous, fiery atmosphere of the Infernal theme. These tracks will also be added to the [b]Soundtrack DLC[/b] once the update goes live.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3951500/The_King_is_Watching_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Free for All Kings[/b][/h2][p]All of this content will be [b]free[/b] [b]for everyone who owns the game[/b]. Consider it a humble token of our gratitude for your overwhelming support and the love you’ve shown our little project.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until next time! HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][b][i]~ The Hypnohead Team[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: The King is Answering your Questions: Q&A Part 2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Once again, the royal court has been filled with your questions. We thank you for your curiosity, your passion, and even your unexpected requests! Today we bring you another round of answers straight from the throne. Let us begin, [b]onward!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/3d21fdf1d919766e5f5bcd82b410cee307c88380.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Any plans to add VO to the game?
[/b]A: We actually prototyped an announcer who would comment on waves and resource shortages. In practice, though, we felt it broke the flow and immersion of the game. For now, we don’t plan to add VO.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are there plans to add new councillors, maybe through a community challenge?
[/b]A: Yes! We already have about 20 more councillors in prototypes, and some of them will definitely make it into the game over time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why can’t the Tavern consume wine to increase morale?
[/b]A: If you mean why wine is always consumed during battle: that’s a balancing decision. Wine provides a strong morale bonus, and we didn’t want to gate it behind a building. Because it’s always consumed, it’s relatively easier to stockpile compared to other high-level resources like meat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/150106b419cfbabf8c4460cc99231634d21c95fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will there be a barracks that only uses wine, like Viking warriors?
[/b]A: Maybe :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could each King have their own independent advisor setup?
[/b]A: That’s a QoL feature we’d like to add, but it requires a big rework of how advisor choices are stored. So it’s on our list, but low priority.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why didn’t you tie Threat Level unlocks to specific Kings, so you’d have to replay from scratch with each one?
[/b]A: We discussed this a lot. Both systems have merits. We chose a more liberal system to give players freedom: you can replay each difficulty per King, or jump straight to higher Threat Levels with a newly unlocked King.[/p][p]Achievements for reaching maximum Threat Level still encourage trying each King, though.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/2c9aa66e843f675c76ee7ddb64ed322f04cf86c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why can’t you get more than six spells?
[/b]A: This is a balancing choice to keep spell slots limited. You can increase the limit with a specific advisor, and you can also stack multiple copies of the same spell. This keeps the cap soft while pushing players to actually use the spells and not hoard them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will Endless Mode be available in Threat Levels 2, 3, and 4?
[/b]A: We limited Endless Mode to specific Threat Levels so the leaderboards stay fair and easy to follow. That won’t change for now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Who is your favourite King to play as?
[/b]A: For our lead designer, it’s King Spellus. For our publishing producer, King Saladin. And we’ve all had fun with Baldwin’s grunt builds :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/15e45ecfff45bc7a77f69bcaa2afd5a58eca034c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Can you remove the restriction of only being able to take each artifact once?
[/b]A: Hm, that’s actually an interesting idea for a councillor ability.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you add a button to gather all units at once, like the deploy-all button?
[/b]A: This and also “presets” of units were requested a lot, but even if we add this functionality it’s a low priority improvement for us at the moment.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you make the small gold and iron mines more distinct?
[/b]A: We’ll think about it, thanks! We know there’s a popular mod that does exactly this, so it’s worth exploring.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/1bf7ea0ce1c8b6fd2d4b265de2516e1c4c27ad2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Can you add the possibility to place orders at the trader for specific items?
[/b]A: Not at the moment, it would break the balance of the current system. But we do want to make builds more predictable in the future, so this might change as we refine things.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Is it planned to add the possibility to play as a bad guy?
[/b]A: What makes you think you’re playing as a good guy now? ;) But we will add more ways to feel bad, but cool.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What was your most useful marketing beat?
[/b]A: Steam Next Fest brought us the largest number of wishlists. But in the long run, pivoting the game more towards roguelike mechanics, and thus making it more marketable, was even more important.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Is there an opportunity to join your team as a QA engineer?
[/b]A: There are two ways to contribute:[/p][list][*][p]We recruit volunteer testers from time to time, so keep an eye on our Discord announcements.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re not hiring QA managers right now, but we are looking for another GameMaker developer to join the project. You can apply on tinyBuild's website.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/d0ab166cad62c5429507f5975073a79aa28a630a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That is all for today's royal friends. Your questions inspire us, your support strengthens us, and your love for the game keeps our kingdom growing. We will return soon with another scroll of answers. [b]HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]~The Hypnohead Devs[/b][/i][/p]

tags.balance_change:
Why can’t the Tavern consume wine to increase morale?
A: If you mean why wine is always consumed during battle: that’s a balancing decision. Wine provides a strong morale bonus, and we didn’t want to gate it behind a building. Because it’s always consumed, it’s relatively easier to stockpile compared to other high-level resources like meat.

Why can’t you get more than six spells?
A: This is a balancing choice to keep spell slots limited. You can increase the limit with a specific advisor, and you can also stack multiple copies of the same spell. This keeps the cap soft while pushing players to actually use the spells and not hoard them.

Can you add the possibility to place orders at the trader for specific items?
A: Not at the moment, it would break the balance of the current system. But we do want to make builds more predictable in the future, so this might change as we refine things.

notes.title: Mid-Run Saving is here with Update 1.0.3!
notes.content:
[p][b]Noble Kings![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today we bring news you’ve long awaited: [b]Mid-Run Saving Is Here![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnM5c3VlZnJuM25ibHU3d3ZrZzBnbmhrcmcya2VkcXdvN3F0b2kzOSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GmIy7JVNghdG3jCtVF/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each time you complete a wave, the game will [b]automatically save[/b] your progress. You can now safely choose “Quit and Save” from the pause menu, then return to your kingdom later exactly where you left off.[/p][p][/p][p]This improvement comes alongside the[b] 1.0.3 Update[/b], with even more balance, QoL, and technical improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update 1.0.3 Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Mid-Run Saves[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Each time you complete a wave, the game automatically saves your progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Safely select [b]"Quit and Save"[/b] from the pause menu and resume your kingdom exactly where you left off.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Technical Improvements and QoL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash related to particle systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal Castle and Balloon Bomber units can now be moved in and out of barracks. The "Comfy Bed" artifact now allows recruiting more of these troops per building.[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemists and the Witch boss now correctly apply production slowdown to buildings with thrown bottles.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the Dragon boss modifier (-50% spell damage) not calculating correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell damage multiplier now shows 100% if no modifiers are applied.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Spells[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fireworks duration increased from 8s → 12s.[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Fireworks duration increased from 10s → 18s.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bosses and Troops[/b][/p][p][b]Graveyard Golem:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 33,000 → 36,000[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 280 → 330[/p][/*][*][p]Fallen Soldiers spawned: 8 → 16[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies spawned: 8 → 12[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Malathrax:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 23,000 → 26,000[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 300 → 330[/p][/*][*][p]Fireball Damage: 70 → 100[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Venoxia:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attack Damage: 220 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bat:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 35 → 75[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 7 → 9[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Whipman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 60 → 120[/p][/*][*][p]Whip Cooldown: 3s → 1.5s[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Madman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 70 → 100[/p][/*][/list][p][b]All Druids:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Transformation time: 20s → 12s[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Reaper:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 8,000 → 6,000[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Pikeman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 10,000 → 8,000[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Bamboo Warrior:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 8,000 → 7,000[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Kings[/b][/h3][p][b]Brezhnius:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heal Ability: 500 HP → 1,000 HP[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Leonid:[/b][/p][list][*][p]First quest required Castle HP: 10 → 30[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Leo:[/b][/p][p][b][i]Developer Comment:[/i][/b][i]

notes.title: The King is Watching: Release Plans & What’s Coming Next! 👑
notes.content:
[i][b]Loyal rulers, gather around! [/b][/i]

We are overwhelmed (like by an enemy invasion, but in a good way!) by the sheer amount of feedback we received after Steam Next Fest. Not only have you shared your thoughts and strategies, but over [b]180,000[/b] of you have [b]wishlisted the game[/b]. I would bow to you but the crown would fall (and we don’t want that, do we?)

Our goal today is to share with you what's coming in the 1.0 version. We will also discuss what we want to add to the game after release. To put it simply: [b]more content, more choices, and more ways to rule your kingdom[/b]. With the core of the game polished and stable, we’re expanding and refining it based on your feedback.

[b]Our focus right now is fully on 1.0[/b], but we want to make it clear: this won’t be the end of the journey. While this article is all about what’s coming in the full release, we also plan to continue developing the game beyond launch, [b]so more on that when the time comes![/b]

Let’s dive into the details at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/024d0393165eb727883bc1521fe6dd507a7fb623.gif[/img]

[h2][b]A New King, A New Playstyle[/b][/h2]

The King’s current power is to move blocks across the battlefield. With the release version we will introduce at least one [b]new playable King[/b], each with his own unique powers that [b]evolve the gameplay[/b] and change the way you strategize!

[h2][b]The Royal Council: More Than Just Advisors[/b][/h2]

Advisors will be a major feature in the full game, [b]not just for passive bonuses[/b] but as [b]a way to shape your playthrough[/b]. While the core set of buildings and units remains the same, [b]advisors will determine which blueprints and soldiers you can access[/b], allowing you to avoid those that don’t suit your strategy. Think of them as a way to customize your kingdom’s loadout. Choose wisely, as their influence will define your reign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f36083c3efb1db1e14d00fabe5219299f45b18c0.png[/img]

[h2][b]Ascension: The Challenge Awaits[/b][/h2]

Think you’ve mastered the kingdom? [b]Think again![/b] Once you finish with the base difficulty, you’ll unlock [b]Ascensions, extra challenge modifiers[/b] that will push even the most seasoned rulers to their limits. Our goal is to have at least [b]7–8 Ascensions[/b], including brutal changes like facing three bosses in a single run instead of two. Now THAT’s a challenge worthy of the most wise Kings!

[h2][b]A New Level: The Undead Rise![/b][/h2]

By 1.0, we’ll be adding [b]at least one more level[/b], and this one comes with a chilling theme: [b]necromancy and the undead[/b]. This cursed land will allow you to mount expeditions to unearth powerful artifacts, all while dealing with new threats, unique bosses, and dark magic. Me? Afraid? Of course not, but we will still look from a safe distance…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/4e07416de235ff43476f995d22bb069a56f57f2d.gif[/img]

[h2][b]More Bosses, More Surprises![/b][/h2]

Currently, the demo has [b]two fixed bosses[/b]… but we want [b]more[/b]! In the full game, your opponent will be [b]randomized[/b] at the start of each run, [b]adding new challenges and twists[/b]. A fortune teller will even forewarn you of the enemy general you’ll face, [b]each one bringing special modifiers to your playthrough[/b]. Some may freeze your buildings. Others will make each wave stronger. And some? They might just resurrect fallen enemies as skeletons. How rude of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/6ba41d4cb146ce5c69757d3b8f733670976e4f81.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Expanded Events System![/b][/h2]

We’re also enhancing our event system to provide clearer resolutions to your choices. Spared an enemy? Had them “removed” from the equation? The consequences of your royal decrees will be spelled out in greater detail, so you’ll always know exactly what fate you’ve sealed!
We’ve also heard your love for the witty, varied events (and their charming illustrations!), so rest assured: more are on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/8f1cd01e1c5aa872b03d5c7cad80f32fed627086.png[/img]

[h2][b]And Of Course More… Everything![/b][/h2]

Expect [b]tons of additional buildings, units, and spells to expand your tactical options[/b]. This is just a glimpse of what we’re planning, so rest assured, there’s much more to come.

We’ll share more details in future updates, but for now, [b]thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm[/b]. Your kingdom awaits, and the future of [b]The King is Watching[/b] has never looked brighter! [b]HUZZAH![/b]

notes.title: New Demo Results & What’s Next for The King is Watching! 👑
notes.content:
Loyal rulers, gather ‘round! The kingdom has never been more bustling! Over 240,000 of you have played the demo. That's a lot of ruling, strategizing, and, let’s be honest, occasional catastrophic mismanagement. But fear not! We’ve been watching (as always) and gathering your feedback to shape the future of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/eeb0c4d69020e49f42bc92fe91a987c77019784a.png[/img]

[h3][b]The People Have Spoken (And We’re Listening, not only Watching!)[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Loop Hero Comparisons:[/b] Many of you have compared us to Loop Hero, which is a massive honor. While we’re thrilled with the overwhelmingly positive reviews (97% positive!), we also know there’s still work to do.
[*] [b]Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] Only 30% of surveyed players managed to defeat the boss. We've seen some crazy survival records, but we acknowledge that reaching the end is a bit difficult right now. We'll work on game balancing. But don’t worry, true masochists, we’ve got you covered: the full release will include Ascensions, with extra challenge modes for those who crave suffering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/608778446c389a240e8c158b9fa98a8860fbddf9.png[/img]

[*] [b]More Buildings, More Content, More Music: [/b]more buildings, more mechanics, more units, and more levels are on the way. And yes, your ears will be pleased with more music tracks!
[*] [b]Resource Management Tweaks:[/b] We designed resource gathering to push players toward different strategies, but we understand that it can feel frustrating. We’ll be looking into improvements and adding clearer explanations in the tutorial and tooltips.
[*] [b]Spells & Power Scaling:[/b] Ah yes, the Bladefall. We know it wasn’t exactly a fan favorite, and spell damage currently doesn’t scale well. Expect more powerful spells and better ways to increase their effectiveness as the game progresses.
[*] [b]Encounters:[/b] You liked them! So we’ll be expanding on them. At the very least, we’ll add clearer descriptions of the consequences of your choices. Maybe even some long-term effects!
[*] [b]Meta-Progression:[/b] This will be expanded significantly! Beyond purchasing upgrades, you’ll have to complete specific challenges to unlock new features. And of course, councilors will play a major role: you won’t be able to choose them all at once, meaning each playthrough will force tough decisions.
[*] [b]More Enemies, More Bosses, More Mayhem:[/b] Expect a greater variety of enemies and multiple bosses per level. Your final showdown will be decided randomly from a pool of level-specific bosses, each bringing their own unique challenge modifier. Some will debuff extra tiles, others will try to set everything on fire (literally).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/adec71f03f8f7f56f2e81a190fd21269f8c3dca1.png[/img]

[h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3]

We will be revealing more details about our plans for the full release very soon, so stay tuned! Right now, we’re still collecting your feedback and fine-tuning our vision for the game accordingly. If you haven’t yet filled out the survey, now’s your chance:

[b]Fill out the survey here:[/b] https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-bTlRxqGEgtMkxMEutqNaagRYPJ2pb2BsDYjdVAcfNwOOkw/viewform?usp=sharing

We’re also keeping a close eye on the Steam Community Hub and especially our Discord, where discussions, debates, and the occasional kingdom-wide conspiracy unfold. 

[b]Join us here:[/b] https://discord.gg/7yf97dNPV2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f02c9952b929fc71a4e3936e19086b56ae077bf3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Thank You for Playing![/b][/h3]

Your feedback is shaping the game’s future, and we’re beyond grateful. Follow the game to stay updated, and join the community to share your thoughts, strategies, and kingdom-wide conspiracies. HUZZAH!

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.4
notes.content:
[b]Loyal subjects, hear ye![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has shared feedback on our discord as well as steamcommunity forums. Update 0.5.4 contains balance changes aimed at buffing underpowered troops and making them more viable. The enemy waves were also rebalanced and are now harder after the 1st boss, yet the late game troops can take care of them. As these troops are much more useful now, there are more builds to play around.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

TROOPS:
[list]
[*] Late game troops are stronger now and are produced faster (and cheaper)
[*] Dragon Boss' HP, damage and fire breath damage are increased. Now he performs his special ability 3 times instead of 2
[/list]

BUILDINGS:
[list]
[*] Late game buildings are cheaper and more obtainable
[/list]

SPELLS:
[list]
[*] The spells unlocked via the upgrade tree are more powerful now
[/list]

ENEMY WAVES
[list]
[*] Waves after the first boss are harder and more tankier. As a result you have to rely more on the quality of your army rather than the damaging spells (spells are still very useful)
[/list]


NEW BUILDINGS UPGRADES:

Stables:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]
Dragon oven: 
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[*] Increases attack speed by 20%
[/list]
Archery:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2 (replaced extra attack speed upgrade)
[/list]
Academy of fire:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[*] PREVIOUS upgrade reworked: now sets enemies on fire, dealing bonus damage over time
[*] Ballista factory:
[/list]
[list]
[*] Increases damage by 15% and applies slow to enemies shot
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]
Catapult factory:
[list]
[*] Catapults receive 20% chance to stun enemies
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]

OTHER:
[list]
[*] Mill and forge can now be found both in Building T1 and T2 upgrades making them more common. Their production speed is also increased by about 50%
[*] Spells are more rare now and the building upgrades are more common among the rewards
[*] Cronenberg unit is now time limited and can no longer be used to spawn an infinite amount of junior cronenbergs
[*] Twin arrows artifact no longer buffs just crossbowmen, now it buffs all of the ranged units, damage boost reduced: 6% -> 3%
[*] Wine excavations now provides 1 wine for each Wheat field or Small wheat field every 10 seconds
[*] Productive and poor tiles are now removed by default. Instead you can unlock 2 productive tiles via the upgrade tree
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*] Some ui fixes improving usability
[*] New branch of the game for the people who experience Win32 function 0x887a0005 CRASH
[*] (has to be in a separate branch as it is a little unstable sometimes)
[/list]
